o.text: From Proto-Turkic *teriŋ (“deep”). Cognate with Turkish derin, Bashkir тәрән (tärän), Chuvash тарӑн (tarăn) etc.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish دیوار (dīvār), from Persian دیوار (divâr).
Borrowed from Persian غلبیر (ġalbir), from Arabic غِرْبَال (ḡirbāl).
From doğramaq (“to cut into small pieces, chop, crumble”) + -mac. Compare the semantic parallel to окро́шка (okróška).
Synonymous compound of söz + sov. The latter part is from Proto-Turkic *sāb (“word”).
